Subject: Door-to-door fleet options and constraints for Nov 30 offsite

Hi team,

Quick kickoff on ground transport for the Nov 30 Acme executive offsite at the Harbor Conference Center. Agenda and headcount attached in the Drive link below, but immediate asks:

- We need door-to-door options for 36 attendees (executives + a few guests) arriving between 8:00–10:30am and departures between 5:30–7:30pm.
- Priority: predictable SLA for pickups (15-min window), guaranteed parking for 12 cars at the venue, and an accessible option for two attendees with mobility needs.
- Budget target: keep shuttle/car-service + valet under $3,200 day-of if possible; rental block for 4 cars as overflow.

Initial vendor list I want to evaluate: BlueCar Logistics (car service + shuttles), CityValet (on-site valet + event parking patches), Lyft Business (rideshare fallback and promo codes). Marcus — can you lead vendor quotes and slot an intro call with BlueCar this week? Laura — can you confirm parking layout with the venue and request 12 passes? Evelyn — please draft the mobility plan for the two attendees (vehicle specs + drop-off spot).

Attachments: parking_map_downtown_v2.pdf (placeholder in Drive).

Thanks — short timelines here, so aiming to lock vendors by Nov 17.

Best,
Jordan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Day-of run of show highlights:
- 07:00 — Vendor load-in and staging at South Loading Bay (venue contact: Karen Li).
- 07:30 — Valet open / greeters on the plaza.
- 08:00–10:30 — Continuous shuttle windows; sedans on scheduled pickups per cluster.
- 17:30–19:30 — Return windows and overflow rideshare coordination.

Next operational items: BlueCar ops to share detailed pickup timing per cluster by 11/24. CityValet to share staffing roster and hang-tag print by 11/25. Laura to send venue insurance cert to CityValet and BlueCar. Marcus: finalize Lyft codes and rental confirmations.
